note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and worker are described, workers dimorphic; values marked with c in the original are given here as their stated values; nomenclatural and type-material records, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to light brown; nasus dark reddish brown, paler at base, concolorous with head; antennae light brown, paler than head; thorax cream yellow, anterior margin of pronotum tinged with brown; intestinal contents visible through abdomen. Head with a pair of hairs at base of nasus, a pair of long hairs slightly below the middle, and a few short minute hairs elsewhere; nasus with a pair of long hairs and several short hairs near the tip, sometimes with one or two very long hairs; pronotal margins and body with a few short hairs; each abdominal tergite with several short hairs and two pairs of longer hairs on posterior margin; last few tergites and sternites with several long and short hairs. Body length about 4.2–4.5 mm. Head subcircular, wider than long excluding nasus (1.58–1.70 mm long including nasus, 0.90–1.03 mm long excluding nasus, 0.95–1.05 mm maximum width); in lateral view depressed behind nasus, without nasus swelling. Nasus thick, conical, tapering anteriorly, shorter than head length excluding nasus (0.60–0.75 mm long, nasus length/head length excluding nasus 0.709–0.806). Fontanelle tube distinct in some head capsules and nasi. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 4 shortest. Mandibles vestigial, without apical teeth. Postmentum subquadrate, weakly narrowed posteriorly (0.28–0.30 mm long, 0.25–0.28 mm maximum width, 0.23–0.25 mm minimum width). Pronotum saddle-shaped, wider than long (0.26–0.28 mm long, 0.48–0.50 mm wide); anterior margin faintly notched at middle; posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule cream yellow to pale yellow; antennae, postclypeus and legs paler than head; thorax cream yellow; abdomen transparent, intestinal contents visible. Head and body densely hairy. Body length about 4.0–4.6 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long to base of mandibles (1.15–1.20 mm long to apex of labrum, 0.77–0.83 mm long to base of mandibles, 0.90–1.03 mm maximum width); Y-shaped suture indistinct. Fontanelle plate elliptical, translucent. Antennae 13–14-segmented; with 13 segments segments 3 and 4 subequal, segment 4 sometimes longer and subdivided; with 14 segments segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus weakly inflated (0.15–0.17 mm long, 0.45 mm wide). Pronotum saddle-shaped. Minor worker: similar to major worker but smaller.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, with a pair of linear markings between fontanelle plate and postclypeus; antennae and legs light brown; pronotum slightly paler than head capsule, with a paler T-shaped mark (with short stem) and a pair of pale median spots above posterior margin; abdominal tergites as dark as pronotum, sternites paler, paler medially; wings light brown. Head and body densely hairy. Body length about 10.00–12.50 mm with wings, 6.00–7.20 mm without wings. Head capsule subcircular, wider including compound eyes than long to base of mandibles (1.23–1.25 mm long to apex of labrum, 0.85–0.95 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.10–1.18 mm wide including compound eyes). Fontanelle plate elongate-elliptical (0.10–0.13 mm long, 0.05–0.06 mm wide). Compound eyes subcircular (0.30–0.35 mm maximum diameter, 0.28–0.30 mm minimum diameter). Ocelli broadly elliptical (0.13 mm long, 0.10 mm wide), separated from compound eye by about 1/2 their width. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus weakly inflated, less than 1/2 as long as wide (0.18 mm long, 0.45–0.50 mm wide); anteclypeus trapezoidal, transparent, projecting anteriorly at middle. Labrum dome-shaped, wider than long (0.28–0.30 mm long, 0.35–0.43 mm wide). Pronotum trapezoidal, slightly narrower than head including compound eyes, wider than long (0.60–0.68 mm long, 0.88–0.98 mm wide); anterior margin nearly straight, slightly raised, with a faint median notch; posterior margin convex, deeply incised at middle. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum deeply and angularly incised. Wings light brown, hairy on margins and at tips (length including wing scales: forewing 9.5–11.00 mm, hindwing 9.0–10.0 mm).
